What if you ate garlic every day?
Garlic is related to onions, leeks and chives. Your breath might scare people away. Garlic has been used in cooking and medicine for thousands of years.

But here's the twist. Garlic smell comes from compounds that get into your blood and lungs, so you breathe it out for hours, even after brushing your teeth! Eating an apple or drinking milk with garlic may reduce the smell. Raw, chopped garlic gives off even more of those smelly compounds than cooked garlic.
